result:
I wrote `component.html` in the folder, but I haven't opened it in a browser, so the rendering is unchecked.

It follows the v4 "Screens" rules in `DESIGN.md`:
- **Page:** it sits on white inside `#component` at 1280px, with a 1120px centered column, 48px of space above it and 32px side padding.
- **Top row:** the "Notifications" heading is on the left in Unbounded Light capitals. "Mark All as Read" is on the right as the one ink primary pill, 44px tall.
- **List:** the six notifications are in one card, with 52px rows and 1px dividers.
- **Unread state:** the first three rows have an accent dot and semibold text. The dot is aria-hidden and there is no hidden "Unread" text, so screen readers get no unread state. I left it out because you asked for exactly this content.
- **Tokens:** the tokens I use are inlined from `tokens.css`, with no raw colour values in the component styles.

Unbounded and Archivo aren't in the folder, so they will fall back to `system-ui` unless they're installed on the machine that renders it.
